items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Sandy Williams played like him. ... To me, now, he was the closest to Jimmy Harrison ... Sandy was with Fletcher's band for a while, too

ctx.x: And a lot of trombone players stole his style, you know. I tell you who sounded closest to him, of the trombone players almost of today, I'll say. Sandy Williams played like him.
